items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: No, I remember Bonk. That's when my daddy used to do it.

ctx.x: But I did play with me, you know, recently, you see. But they don't know my life. They're twenty-five years younger than me. They don't know when I started. They don't know all the bands I played with. You know what I mean? But they would be in the rocks.
Do you remember Bonk, by the way?
No, I remember Bonk. That's when my daddy used to do it.
